dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Our conclusion is that Claude Mythos 5 does not cross the CB-2 threshold, but this is a much less clear and obvious judgment than with previous models.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: CB-1/CB-2 determinations plus VCT 0.56, long-form virology 0.77/0.91, uplift trials.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Mythos 5 scored a mean of 10.44 capability flags across ExploitBench's 41 V8 environments in the plain arm
dc_eval_cyber.note: Scores on ExploitBench, OSS-Fuzz, CyberGym, Firefox 147; Tier 1 determination. Run on Mythos 5, the same weights as Fable 5.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: We assess that Claude Mythos 5 does not cross the automated AI R&D capability threshold of our RSP and FCF.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: Automated AI R&D threshold determination with task-based evaluations in 2.3.7.

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: based on our findings below, we believe the model has not crossed the Tier 2 threshold.
dc_eval_persuasion.note: Influence-campaign task completion 67.1% and 46.8%, Tier 2 determination.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Our automated offline monitoring did not surface any instance of evaluation sandbagging, overtly malicious actions, long-horizon strategic deception, or long-horizon strategic oversight evasion.
dc_eval_scheming.note: Many results: SHADE-Arena stealth 14.4%, evaluation awareness measures, sandbagging review.

framework_threshold.quote: As with many previous models, we are treating Mythos 5 as CB-1 and applying ASL-3 protections to Fable 5
framework_threshold.note: CB-1 treated, CB-2 not crossed, autonomy threat model 2 not applicable, cyber Tier 1.

ext_test_any.quote: METR assessed a pre-release snapshot of Mythos 5 against the automated AI R&D threat model from our Responsible Scaling Policy and FCF.
ext_test_any.note: METR, UK AISI, Deloitte, Dyno, Gray Swan and others tested pre-release.

ext_test_named_org.quote: METR assessed a pre-release snapshot of Mythos 5 against the automated AI R&D threat model from our Responsible Scaling Policy and FCF.
ext_test_named_org.note: METR named; also Deloitte, Apollo not named, UK AISI, Andon Labs, Gray Swan.

ext_test_government.quote: UK AISI was given access to a pre-release checkpoint of [Claude Mythos 5] to test for behaviours relevant to misalignment risk.
ext_test_government.locator: 6.2.4 External testing from the UK AI Security Institute
ext_test_government.note: UK AISI also tested cyber capability (3.2.5) and safeguards (3.3.1).

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: METR assessed a pre-release snapshot of Mythos 5 against the automated AI R&D threat model from our Responsible Scaling Policy and FCF.

safeguards_training.quote: the fully-trained versions of these models—which include harmlessness training—refused to engage with these tasks essentially from the first turn
safeguards_training.note: Harmlessness training also in 2.2.1 and section 4 evaluations.

safeguards_runtime.quote: We prevent harmful cyber use in two stages. First, a probe looks at Claude’s internal activations, screening all traffic.
safeguards_runtime.note: Probe plus LLM classifier; ASL-3 blocking classifiers in 1.5.

safeguards_access.quote: we are rolling out a trusted access program that will allow access to Claude Mythos 5’s biologically-relevant capabilities for vetted users with targeted beneficial use cases.
safeguards_access.note: Mythos 5 limited to Project Glasswing partners; cyber verification program.

safeguards_weights.quote: real-time classifier guards, access controls for guard exemptions, a bug bounty program and threat intelligence, rapid-response options for jailbreaks, and security controls against model weight theft
safeguards_weights.note: Weight security applied to CB-1 treatment; ASL-3 security controls maintained.
